title: R2 dashboard rubric DTO
description: Presentation projection of the active outcome-scoring rubric for the R2 dashboard rubric-explainer view. Returned by GET /api/rubric. Sourced from internal/scoring.DefaultRubric() at process start (spec R4): version, combination method, the signal set with weights + labels + descriptions, and the band ladder. Read-only; the rubric is versioned (spec D3) so every iteration/run DTO carries the rubric_version it was scored under and the UI flags a mismatch against this active version.

version.description: Active rubric semantic version (Rubric.Version / scoring.RubricVersion, e.g. '2.1.0').

combination.description: How per-signal sub-scores combine (Rubric.Combination / CombinationMethod). v1 only ships weighted_mean_renormalized.

signals.description: The rubric's signals in declared order (Rubric.Signals / SignalSpec). Weights sum to 1.0.

description.description: One-line description of what the signal measures (SignalSpec.Description).

two_way.description: True when the signal has both an objective and a self-reported source and therefore emits an integrity observation (SignalSpec.TwoWay).

bands.description: Score-band ladder sorted descending by min (Rubric.Bands / ScoreBand). The lowest band is anchored at min 0 so every score in [0,1] lands. The 'unscored' band is implicit (no numeric range) and is NOT listed here; DTOs report band 'unscored' when scored is false.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for the band (ScoreBand.Min).
